check.reads: description, documentation (name withheld at extraction), name, unit

gate.development_is_not_a_gate: the bars are measured on fresh names; this development reading is reported for tuning only

labels.note: all agreed names are development data now: they have been scored three times and are used here only to set the threshold
labels.produced_by: two independent readers; neither the phrase check nor any model produced a label
labels.rule: only names both readers agree on: both-flag is a mismatch, both-pass agrees

reverse.rule: a qualifier the name states that the definition does not support, reported apart

thresholds.rule: the lowest threshold whose development false-flag rate is at or under the ceiling and which flags at least one development mismatch; frozen before any fresh name is read
